items.title: Peter Bocage Interview, 1962-02-06
items.q: Yes, I remember him too. He died in Chicago too.

ctx.x: What sort of trumpet player was he? He was all right. He was a head man to him. Sugar Johnny, was he the same?
Sugar Johnny, yes. Yes, I remember him too. He died in Chicago too. I don't remember if Chick's living up there yet, but he was up there. He gave up when he went up there.
Yeah. Yeah, he played around there quite a bit.
